harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Published the staged public and staff trees on node1 at TCP port 8080. Public content is anonymous; staff content requires HTTP Basic authentication as reader. Configuration and content survived the mandatory node restart.
actions_performed: Installed the RHEL-compatible Apache 2.4 packages without changing the OS release or kernel.
Configured /public/ for anonymous access and /staff/ for Basic authentication.
Created a protected bcrypt credential file outside the served trees using the demonstration credential from access.txt.
Disabled directory listings, configured persistent SELinux/firewalld access for TCP 8080, and enabled httpd at boot.
Restarted node1 safely, confirmed its boot identity changed, and repeated functional verification.

evidence.requirement: Serve the supplied trees on TCP port 8080 with persistent service and platform security configuration.
evidence.summary: Apache configuration passed syntax checks; httpd is enabled and active on *:8080; firewalld permits 8080; SELinux remains Enforcing and assigns 8080 to http_port_t.

evidence.requirement: Public pages are anonymous and the supplied pages remain intact.
evidence.summary: Before and after restart, anonymous /public/ returned HTTP 200 and matched the staged public index byte-for-byte.

evidence.requirement: Staff pages require Basic authentication as reader using the demonstration password.
evidence.summary: The protected credential file contains reader with a password hash; valid credentials returned HTTP 200 and exact staged staff index and roster content.

evidence.requirement: Failed authentication leaves all staff content inaccessible.
evidence.summary: Anonymous and deliberately incorrect credentials returned HTTP 401 without leaking the staff index; the roster also returned 401 for both failure cases.

evidence.requirement: Neither credential files nor directory listings are served.
evidence.summary: Authenticated and anonymous credential-file URL probes returned 404. Empty-directory probes returned 403, directly confirming indexes are disabled. Source access.txt remains root-only and the generated htpasswd is root:apache mode 0640.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel.
evidence.summary: RHEL 9.8 and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8 were unchanged across implementation and restart.

Healthy baseline boot ID was 5f3ce3b8-4860-447e-bcf1-d6643718694e; systemd acknowledged the safe reboot; node unavailability was observed; recovered boot ID was cc2adfdc-7071-4830-9863-158942469570. Post-restart service, listener, firewall, SELinux, authentication, exact content, credential-file isolation, and directory-listing checks all passed.
